crossRefs.note: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men, and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be…
But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”

translations.web: Leave the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.
translations.bsb: Leave this work on the house of God alone. Let the governor and elders of the Jews rebuild this house of God on its original site.
translations.kjv: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.
translations.asv: let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.
